notes.title: Season 2 Preview Patch Highlights!
notes.content:
Season 2 will begin on October 18th, but the official "preview" patch has arrived which includes many of the new changes for season 2. Here is a brief summary of the new highlights:

[list]
[*] Runes now drop! Runes may be added to items with open sockets which will permanently modify the item's properties. Each rune provides different properties, and some runes are extremely valuable due to their rarity!
[*] Many items, of all rarity types, may have sockets. Each socket allows for a rune to be added to the item. Runes cannot be removed from an item.
[*] A new ethereal property may appear on all items except for jewelry (rings, amulets, and charms). This property may appear for all rarity types. It will boost the base armor or damage for the armor or weapon, respectively. The only catch is that the item will degrade over time. After the ethereal item drops to 0 durability, the item will be destroyed.
[*] A new Indestructible property now appears on some items. This is a very valuable property in cases where the item is also ethereal because it prevents the item from decaying. A very rare rune can even add the indestructible property to an item!
[*] Runes may be found randomly from mobs and chests. However they are also awarded as part of the King's Reward upon completing each difficulty. Note that the King's Reward drops with a special modifier that increases the odds of finding the rarest runes in the game!
[*] A new global General chat channel is now used in favor of relying on "town" channels. Players no longer default to numbered town channels. Instead they default to a private channel although players may still manually join any channel. The matchmaking and global chat system has made the need for local presence detection in town obsolete.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=Jokmcrrew7U;full][/previewyoutube]

Note that runes and socketed items drop, however you will not be able to access the crafting counter until the start of season 2! In the meantime, we will monitor rune drop rates and consider the need for adjustments before the new season begins!

And one final nugget of news is that we plan on adding support for traditional Chinese. We hope that this will be patched before October! The game has received quite a bit of support in Taiwan and Malaysia in recent weeks, so we plan to provide an ideal translation for those players!

See you on October 18th!

notes.title: Nevergrind Online - Full Release Trailer & Season 1 Announcement
notes.content:
[h3]Official Launch[/h3]

Season 1 of Nevergrind Online officially begins on July 11th, 2024! Steam's first multiplayer blobber first released back on June 9th, 2022. Since that time, development has continued at a steady pace which helped pave the way for its release! Check out the Full Release Official Trailer below! We just updated Nevergrind Online store page with fresh screenshots and the latest trailer, so feel welcome to check that out too!

[previewyoutube=EPbJsPhueNQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Future Development[/h3]

Expect development to continue after season 1 begins. We still have a list of features on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/853450/announcements/detail/5973476545019721850]roadmap[/url] which would be great additions to the game. Originally, we planned to finish everything, but we also want to avoid keeping the game in Early Access for too long. At this time, we believe that the most critical gameplay features have been completed and that now would be a good time for full release. 

There are many features that we would love to add including an auction house, a crafting system, and a mercenary system. We also have many other ideas up our sleeve to help make Nevergrind Online the ultimate cooperative dungeon crawling experience!

For early access players, note that your banked Ladder items will NOT transfer to your Eternal bank. Again, banked Ladder items do [b]NOT[/b] transfer! All Ladder characters and their items will transfer to the Eternal realm at the start of Season 1. Since all characters are moved to the Eternal realm, the Ladder's leaderboard will completely reset and the economy will start fresh.

Druid talent trees have been completed! So what's in store for the druid? Druids can choose to invest in skills across three trees: Flamecaller, Stormcaller, and Gladewalker.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37895771/6b3bc808ccc960a1790267314f7cf133cef0a547.jpg[/img]

[h2]Flamecaller[/h2]
Flamecaller specializes mainly in fire skills such as Starfire, Molten Boulder, and Fissure. They can also invest in Mastery: Armageddon which unleashes additional molten boulders on mobs! Superior Toxic Spores even unlocks a debuff that reduces mob fire resistance which benefits the entire party!

[h2]Stormcaller[/h2]
Stormcaller specializes in a blend of lightning, cold and arcane magic to unleash the power of nature on their adversaries. Choose to invest in spells like Lightning Blast, Tornado, and Blizzard! You may even opt to invest points in Mastery: Hurricane, which unleashes additional tornados on your foes!

[h2]Gladewalker[/h2]
Gladewalker tree focuses on protecting the natural forests and groves that druids draw their spiritual power from. They can choose to empower their healing spells such as Nature's Touch or Synthesize or they can opt to be a brawny protector in the form of a powerful Kodiak!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37895771/4066507ffe68dff805aa675ea8160a2dd096297c.jpg[/img]

With the completion of Druid talents, the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/853450/announcements/detail/5973476545019721850]NGO roadmap[/url] now shows 5/14 class talent trees completed! notes.title: Nevergrind Online Is Big In Japan!
notes.content:
It appears that focusing on localization has been the right decision! [url=https://twitter.com/FmyYch]Ban-chan[/url] graciously offered to help with the translation and I was happy to collaborate. Upon completion and enabling Japanese support, sales in Japan have surged after receiving interest by two prominent sources: 2bro and AUTOMATON. The surge began when [url=https://automaton-media.com/articles/newsjp/20220714-210395/]AUTOMATON released their first article about Nevergrind Online[/url] (NGO). This triggered a sudden and dramatic surge of interest from Japan! I was astonished because it surpassed the surge in sales and players after the Early Access launch.

Prior to localization, very few units were sold in Japan. However, I knew that Japanese was one of the first languages that I wanted to support. I remembered that the Japanese seemed to love the [url=https://nevergrind.com]original Nevergrind, a free browser-based RPG[/url], which was quite limited in comparison to NGO, but it certainly had depth and hand-crafted charm. It was interesting enough to spark a [url=http://blog.livedoor.jp/lkrejg/archives/65919713.html]600+ comment thread about Nevergrind on Livedoor[/url]. For this reason, NGO's success in Japan has not been a complete surprise. I am also aware that games like Wizardry are exceptionally popular. I suppose it makes perfect sense that NGO is big in Japan!

Japanese was the third language that was officially enabled on NGO's Steam store page. This triggered a series of events that resulted in a wild week where the metrics took off like a rocket! It all culminated by hitting 701 peak concurrent users! You can see that the first AUTOMATON article catalyzed a surge on July 14th.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37895771/c88dfb7352c125155f6a5d82985811e8b81358eb.jpg[/img]

The growth persisted for several days and I thought perhaps I would have some breathing room to focus on server optimizations. I was wrong! On July 19th, another Japanese surge happened when 2bro began his broadcast of Nevergrind Online! For those that are not aware, 2bro is one of the largest gaming youtube channels in Japan with over 3 million subscribers. In the weeks ahead, the video will probably be viewed over 200,000 times!

[previewyoutube=XPh_skWIS1k;full][/previewyoutube]

This was interesting to me because I had a hunch that this might happen. I happened to see Otojya's tweet about a "super hot game" that he was excited about.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37895771/a3653f87a5bac971af2b5168781c29f1848b375b.jpg[/img]

I was not sure that Nevergrind Online was making enough waves to get his attention, but it seems that it did!

And, finally, [url=https://automaton-media.com/articles/newsjp/20220719-210915/]AUTOMATON put the cherry on top with their second article about NGO[/url]! What is amazing is that they actually reached out to me via email and requested a second article along with interview questions. I have the utmost respect and admiration for the consummate professionalism of the Japanese media. They have been a joy to work with! 

So here's a quick breakdown of factoids for this exciting week:
[list]
[*] Japan surpasses the United States in total units sold!
[*] All-time peak of 701 concurrent users!
[*] Trending #2 game on steamcharts.com!
[*] Streamed by 2bro to tens of thousands of viewers!
[/list]

One final side note: [url=https://quest-app.appspot.com/download]QTranslate[/url] is an absolutely amazing translation tool! It has made it simple to interact with my player base in Japan! You can select any text, hit CTRL+Q, and you can read anything. This works on Discord, Twitch, YouTube, and emails. This even works inside of NGO itself! Japanese players seem astonished that I can interact them with such ease, but this tool has been my secret weapon!

notes.title: 200: Early Access 0.12.37 - July 4, 2022 3:05 AM EST
notes.content:
• Added Chinese as well as the ability to select between English and Chinese in the options. This status will be updated on the Steam store page, today.
• Ice resistance now reduces the power of chill on your attack and skill haste (GCD). If you have 75 ice resistance, it will change the chill penalties from 50% to 12.5%
• Possibly fixed the infamous potion glitch? Let me know if it went away. It is difficult to duplicate.

• Fixed a bug that was causing the Sanguine Harvest (SHD) proc to indicate undefined in the combat log.
• Elemental damage is now called out much more clearly in the combat log with colored text.
• Fixed (ROG) Talisman of Treachery. It no longer indicates damage on the tooltip.
• Deleting a guild leader will now also delete the entire guild and its members (not the character, just the membership).
• Fixed the Half Elf bonus to defense and archery. Fixed the Wood Elf bonus to archery. They were either not applied at all or not applied correctly.
• Heal-over-time component now appears in their skill tooltip for (DRU) Nature's Touch and (SHM) Rejuvenate.
• Duration timers for mob DoTs are no longer shown since they're short in duration and intended to be more mysterious because they are not cast by an ally. Ally buff durations are still shown.
• Fixed a bug related to Screaming Ire's proc. The tooltip and buff were not working correctly.
• Improved tooltips for mob status debuffs. Previously they were not working as intended.

notes.title: 199: Early Access 0.12.36 - July 2, 2022 2:48 AM EST

• Fixed the calculations and display of everything related to resist physical (Steelclash).

notes.title: 189: Early Access 0.12.26 - June 27, 2022 11:15 PM EST
notes.content:
• Made billions and BILLIONS of changes underneath that will aid with the localization process. Be on the lookout for undefined references in game text and let me know if you find any.
• Fixed Barbarian's ice spell damage bonus.
• Adjusted the mob-to-player damage mitigation on (ENC) Stasis Field. It does more mitigation at lower levels, but less at higher levels. The player-to-mob ratio was not changed.
• Changed (WLK) Bloodfire to a fire spell + DoT from blood.
• Reduced (SHM) Poison Nova's cast time from 4 to 3 seconds.
• Reduced the cast time of (WLK) Blood Fire and Demonic Pact by half a second.
• Reduced the duration of several WLK DoT spells. This makes their debuff time shorter, but they will do more damage as a trade-off.
• Reduced (TMP) Primordial Sludge's duration from 45 to 30 seconds.
• Reduced the threat on (CRU) Benevolence from 250% to 80%.
• Introduced caps for how much mobs can be slowed by mob tier. For example a boss cannot be slowed as much as a regular mob. Slows are also less potent against higher tier mobs. For example, a 25% slow will not reduce a boss's attack speed by the full 25%.
• Reduced (BRD) Euphonic Dirge's duration from 21 to 18.
• Reduced (BRD) Subverted Symphony's duration from 30 to 24.
• Added a 25% slow to (SHM) Vampiric Gaze giving them a bit more utility in a group. Also made it instant cast.
• Reduced (SHM) Scourge's cast time from 3 to 2 seconds.
• Reduced duration of Scourge from 18 to 15 second duration.
• Reduced (SHM) Affliction from 27 to 18 second duration.
• Reduced (SHM) Poison Bolt from 3.5- to 3-second cast time.
• Disabled target toggle when clicking a player card or hitting the hotkey repeatedly.
• Redesigned the skill tooltip to be more readable. The skill description section now focuses more heavily on pure description without inserting dynamic numbers throughout. This will be handy later for localization and future buff descriptions.
• Warrior's Shield Slam now taunts, but has a short 7-second cooldown.
• Fixed an order-of-operations bug that caused a bunch of undefined references in rare cases.

notes.title: Nevergrind Online Smashes Expectations!
notes.content:
I don't even know where to begin. I barely slept this weekend due to being 24/7 wired on the dopamine rush of an early access launch that obliterated all of my expectations. Sure, we had a few bumps along the way supporting hundreds of users, but I worked through it and everyone was quite patient as I worked on putting out fires. By the way, keep in mind that this has all been accomplished with [b]zero[/b] legitimate marketing effort. The only reason it shot off like a rocket was due to gamers finding [b]exactly[/b] what they were craving in Nevergrind Online.

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FVMChZtWIAEiuf1?format=jpg&name=900x900[/img]

If you don't have time to read everything, here are the metrics throughout the first four days:
[list]
[*] Easily clearing 1,000 copies sold
[*] 118/118 positive reviews for a "Very Positive" 100% rating
[*] #3 Hot Release on [url=https://steamdb.info/]steamdb.info[/url] and still trending [b]UPWARD[/b]
[/list]

Without a doubt, my favorite part is the 118/118 positive reviews! I want every player to feel that every penny was money well spent! I know that, for many, finances are tough right now. I have been there, so I understand how difficult that can be. That's why I have complete respect for every dollar that is spent on Nevergrind Online. That's why I will never put microtransactions in the game. That's why I pack so much content, features, and replayability into an online game that costs a mere $20. I will never sell out to the outrageous monetization practices in the gaming industry that are destroying my childhood hobby. Once you buy Nevergrind Online, it is yours to play forever. I want my customers to think that my game is [i]underpriced[/i].

My passion is to design a multiplayer world where players socialize, make friends, organize, and overcome challenges in the game. I love watching players theorycraft in Discord and seeing "lfm", "lfg" in game chat. The game world feels so vibrant and [b]alive[/b] with players that are excited to tackle the next challenge. It reminds me of the early days as a player on Fennin Ro when EverQuest was released in 1999. And that's exactly the kind of excitement that I wanted to generate with Nevergrind Online!

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FVMChZuWIAA8Qb-?format=jpg&name=900x900[/img]

I also want to say [b]THANK YOU[/b] for all of the incredible support. I believe in Nevergrind Online. I know how hard myself, the artists, and the testers have worked on polishing it to its current state. I know all of the nitty gritty details that required strenuous attention to detail to get certain key features engineered to perfection. However, even I did not expect the overwhelming support and positive responses that the game has enjoyed on Steam in its first four days. Thank you for taking time to write those reviews, to stream the game on Twitch, to join the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/853450]Steam group[/url], and to share it with your friends. Remember, almost all of Nevergrind Online's success has been via Steam Store presence and by word of mouth. I haven't paid a dime for advertising or promotion.

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FVMChacWAAIpv2S?format=jpg&name=900x900[/img]

Also, I would like to say thank you for your patience. I easily could have earned a negative review with a few of the bugs that players endured throughout the first four days, but players have been very forgiving and understanding about the complex nature of running Nevergrind Online, the world's first multiplayer blobber with real-time combat (I may need Snopes to debunk me on this).

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FVMChZtXEAI1WTS?format=jpg&name=medium[/img]

Last, but not least, yes, a [b]road map is coming[/b]! It is all in my head, but I will create a dedicated steam news release with all of the planned definite (and potential) changes that I would like to have in the game upon full release! That way players can bookmark it and I can update it at intervals whilst players check on the progress and hold me accountable 😉 

If you are enjoying the game in its current form, then you're going to love what I have in store!

notes.title: Nevergrind Online Launches June 9th, 2022 at 4:20 pm!
notes.content:
The final release date for Nevergrind Online has been set to June 9th, 2022! I will click Steam's shiny [b]Release[/b] button as soon as I get home from work at 4:20 p.m. EST! So it's on 6/9 @ 4:20. Yeah, really. Hey, you won't forget when it released and that's all that matters! 🙃 

I'll be monitoring the game's servers closely upon release to ensure that all players have a great lag-free experience dungeon crawling with their friends! I am incredibly hyped to release the game to the public after five years of development on this game! It has been a long journey and there were times when I was not sure that Nevergrind Online would actually cross the finish line. I will be popping open a bottle of champagne to celebrate its release! 🍾🥂

One final [b]HUGE[/b] thank you to the alpha and beta testers which have been incredibly dedicated and helpful over the last ten months. The progress is all documented in the patch notes in the actual game, so be sure to check out those patch notes to see all of the amazing progress that was made throughout the testing phase. 

Check out these metrics from our test phase:
[list]
[*] 467 testers participated in the beta.

[*] 1,844 characters were created.
[*] 192,250 items were looted.

notes.title: Nevergrind Online Looks Promising for June Release!
notes.content:
[h1]State of the Game[/h1]

Nevergrind Online is in good shape for a June release! We have been working hard since July 2020 when our alpha phase started! Thanks to the hundreds of eager testers that have helped NGO become what it is, today! There have been countless enhancements, suggestions, and bugs that have been resolved thanks to their stalwart efforts! 

Here's a brief milestone overview of features that have been enhanced or completed since the alpha began:
[h2]General[/h2]
✅Single player mode completed.
✅Added a heroic mode to challenge full parties of adventurers.
✅Completed writing the lore for all missions.
✅Sprinkled boss encounters throughout the story mode.
✅Mission quest mobs now have specific drop types.
✅Added a victory screen and King reward to the game.
✅Optimized all images to a very efficient image format.
✅Finished the tavern tips and loading screen tips.
✅Finalized the sound effects.
✅Completed the advanced statistics tab on the character sheet.
✅Added support for 4k monitors.
✅Added a patch history tool within the game.
✅Added a call-to-action prompt that guides the user to certain actions throughout the game.

[h2]Creation[/h2]
✅12 playable races.
✅14 playable classes.
✅Enabled artflow.ai avatars for future unlimited avatar possibilities.
✅Support for 16 avatars per race and 64 avatars for humans.

[h2]Town [/h2]
✅Fully animated town including alternate artwork for four times of day, morning, afternoon, evening, and night.
✅Guild functionality completed.
✅Tavern functionality completed.
✅Apothecary functionality completed.
✅Blacksmith functionality completed.
✅Academy functionality completed.
✅Merchant functionality completed.
✅Bank functionality completed.

[h2]Dungeon[/h2]
✅Completed procedural map generation for 14 different zones.
✅Eliminated party follower map position bugs.
✅Fixed graphical glitches while navigating through dungeons.

[h2]Combat[/h2]
✅Finished class-based adjustments of all skills.
✅Some weapons now have proc effects.
✅Mobs now have a secondary attack cycle that enables them to use certain special skills in addition to their main attack cycle based on their class.
✅Added several new monster champion traits.
✅Added fully integrated DPS meters in the game.

[h2]Itemization[/h2]
✅Unique items have been completed.
✅Set items and their according bonuses have been completed.
✅Chests can now drop potions and scrolls.

[h1]What's Left?[/h1]
At this point, I am focused on optimizations, enhancements, adjustments, and other minor features. The game is very playable and I am doing everything possible to ensure an enjoyable gaming experience for groups of adventurers at launch! Wishlist the game and I'll see you in June!

notes.title: Patch update 133
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Mob trait rampage is now slightly more delayed to give players a chance to react or counter the flurry of attacks.
[*] The number of swings rampage triggers is now limited by mob level. A level 8 mob will swing three times. A level 40 mob will swing seven times. Seven is the max.
[*] Reduced Blizzard cast time from 5 to 4.5 seconds.
[*] MANY spells which previously canceled casting if your target died will now allow you to continue casting. This was particularly adjusted for spells that hit multiple targets. For example, maybe your target died while casting Blizzard, but that's okay! You continue casting and hit the AE targets anyway.
[*] Changed Centurion Shiloh's trait from bloodlusted to spirit drain.
[*] Changed Salubrin Haven's quests from 2/4/6/8 to 1/3/5/7. This gives new players more control over what type of mobs they'll face in the early missions.
[*] Fixed a bug that was causing paralyze to not apply properly by some attacks such as Monk's Palm Strike.
[/list]
